documents.title: Corrigendum To The Notice Of First Extra Ordinary General Meeting Of Financial Year 2026-27.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI Listing Regulations.

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with AUM growing 61% year-on-year to INR 8,001 crores and profit after tax increasing 59% year-on-year to INR 95 crores. The company maintained disciplined asset quality with a credit cost of 6.80% of average AUM, while its capital adequacy ratio in the NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% following the IPO in May 2026. Management reiterated its commitment to expanding both its personal loan and loan against property (LAP) businesses while leveraging AI and technology across underwriting and collections. OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited reported its Q1 FY2027 financial and operational results, highlighting the company's successful listing on NSE and BSE in May 2026. Assets Under Management (AUM) reached 8,001 crore, reflecting a 61% year-on-year growth driven by portfolio expansion.

guidance.claim: The company expects overall AUM growth for the next 12 months to be upwards of 40%.
guidance.quote: Now simple mathematics will tell you that if we have already grown 13% in one quarter, you know, we are only going to overachieve that.

guidance.claim: Management remains firmly on track for the FY27 guidance set out on various parameters including AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability.
guidance.quote: On the guidance for future, we remain firmly on track for the FY27 guidance we set out on different parameters, be it AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability including ROE and ROA.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve AUM growth of over 40% in FY27 with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection.
guidance.quote: We expect to grow at north of 40% in AUM, with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection, while secured business scale-up is also expected to be strong.

guidance.claim: Management targets gross NPA below 2.25% for FY27.
guidance.quote: On asset quality, we are targeting gross NPA below 2.25%, year-on-year reduction in impairment costs of 10%-15%, and continued improvement in Stage-1 mix.

guidance.claim: The company targets a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5% to 5% for FY27.
guidance.quote: On profitability, we are targeting a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5%-5%, which entails a return on average equity in the range of 19-21%.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term opportunity in India for digital credit remains unmistakably gargantuan.
demand_outlook.quote: Beyond the ebb and flow of any single quarter, the long-term opportunity in India remains unmistakably gargantuan.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian economy remains steady, providing stability that lenders value.
demand_outlook.quote: On the macro picture, the Indian economy remains steady, and, as you know, this steadiness is what a lender like us values the most.

demand_outlook.claim: The Personal Loans and Loan Against Property market is projected to grow by a 24% CAGR to 33.4 Trillion by FY30.
demand_outlook.quote: PL and LAP market projected to grow by 24% CAGR, to ₹33.4 Tn by FY30

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the operating environment is weighed down by higher oil prices, elevated rates, geopolitical disruptions, and currency volatility.
demand_outlook.quote: The global environment has been one of the defining themes of the recent past - higher oil prices, elevated rates, geopolitical disruptions, currency volatility, these are all the factors weighing on India too.

demand_outlook.claim: The company views India's long-term structural credit opportunity positively due to economic growth and credit under penetration.
demand_outlook.quote: As we look ahead to FY27, we remain optimistic about India's long-term structural credit opportunity. Many reasons for that, not only economic growth that the country will see, but also the huge degree of credit under penetration which exists, while at the same time being realistic and cautious about near-term conditions.

capex_expansion.claim: The Loan Against Property (LAP) AUM stands at INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states.
capex_expansion.quote: LAP business which we started two years back, the AUM stands at INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states, about 7.7% of the total AUM.

capex_expansion.claim: The subsidiary has secured an AMFI registration to begin building capabilities in mutual fund distribution.
capex_expansion.quote: Our subsidiary has secured an AMFI registration already.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add at least 80 more branches for the Loan Against Property (LAP) business by the end of the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We plan to have at least 80 more branches by end of this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Credit cost for the quarter was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Credit cost was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Operating expenses as a proportion of AUM decreased from 19.9% to 18.0%.
margins_costs.quote: You must have seen the operating leverage some evidence of that, 19.9% cost which was opex as a proportion of AUM has already come down to 18.0% percent.

margins_costs.claim: Impairment cost as a percentage of average AUM dropped from 9.7% in FY25 to 8.2% in FY26 and stood at 7% in Q4.
margins_costs.quote: But the payoff is visible - our impairment cost as a percentage of average AUM has fallen from 9.7% in FY25 to 8.2% in FY26 and in Q4 alone, it stood at 7%.

orders_capacity.claim: Registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million.
orders_capacity.quote: The registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has served 12.25 million customers, marking an increase of 26% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have now served 12.25 million customers, an increase of 26% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Loan Against Property (LAP) AUM stands at nearly ₹518 crore across 98 branches in 8 states, representing 7.3% of total AUM.
orders_capacity.quote: LAP AUM stands at nearly ₹ 518 crore, across 98 branches in 8 states, contributing 7.3% of total AUM.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital adequacy in the NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% in the previous quarter following the IPO.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital adequacy in our NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, supported by retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, nearly four times its level in March 2023, built on retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately ₹630 crore (75% of the primary issue) has already been infused as fresh equity into the NBFC subsidiary, Si Creva Capital.
capital_allocation.quote: 75% of the primary issue, approximately ₹ 630 crore have been already infused as fresh equity into our NBFC subsidiary, which is Si Creva Capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: West Asia presents a risk not of geography, but of transmission through higher oil prices, shipping costs, and customer confidence.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first is West Asia, where the risk is not geography but transmission through higher oil prices, the cost of shipping, and, over time, the confidence of the customer.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry-level bureau data reveals building stress concentrated in small-ticket loans and multiple-lender borrowers.
risks_headwinds.quote: The bureau data for the industry now shows a clear divergence beneath a calm surface.

risks_headwinds.claim: As a measure of prudence, disbursements were reduced by approximately 7% and lending was paused across roughly 450 pin codes flagged for elevated risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: As a measure of prudence, we reduced disbursements by approximately 7% and paused lending across approximately 450 pin codes, where early-warning systems flagged elevated risks - while continuing to grow in high-quality segments.

management_commitments.claim: The company firmly holds to its previous guidance of a 15% reduction in credit cost.
management_commitments.quote: We firmly hold to our guidance which we gave last quarter, which is 15% reduction in credit cost, and we are tracking well on that.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates that the cost of borrowing will drop by 100 basis points in the second half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So our guidance for FY, particularly H2 of FY27, that you will see the cost of borrowing dropping by 100 basis points and it will only increase as we, as the old debt basically runs off the book, right?

management_commitments.claim: The LAP business is expected to achieve breakeven around Q3 of this year.
management_commitments.quote: Till now last year this quarter and around Q3 or so LAP will achieve breakeven.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects funding costs to ease meaningfully over the coming quarters following an A- credit rating obtained in February 2026.
management_commitments.quote: With our recent A- credit rating in February 2026, we expect funding costs to ease meaningfully over the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an AUM growth rate in excess of 40% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to grow at north of 40% in AUM, with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection, while secured business scale-up is also expected to be strong.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets gross NPA below 2.25% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On asset quality, we are targeting gross NPA below 2.25%, year-on-year reduction in impairment costs of 10%-15%, and continued improvement in Stage-1 mix.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5% to 5%, alongside a return on average equity of 19% to 21% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On profitability, we are targeting a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5%-5%, which entails a return on average equity in the range of 19-21%.

management_commitments.claim: The company anticipates potentially receiving another credit upgrade from rating agencies at some point in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are cautiously optimistic on getting another upgrade from both of these institutions at some point in FY27, but that is an active discussion that will happen with the course of next 6 to 8 months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
